executive_summary: The simulated final reviewer requires runtime QoS evidence before approving the design.

findings.claim: Configuration alone does not prove mission traffic survives saturation.

evidence.claim_supported: The fixture shows configuration commands but no runtime impairment measurements.

findings.impact: A deployed system can appear configured correctly while packets still traverse the wrong class or bottleneck.
findings.recommendation: Measure classification counters, qdisc counters, C2 latency, telemetry delivery, and media loss under an enforced bottleneck.

recommendation: Gate approval on real-device impairment evidence.
assumptions_challenged: Presence of tc/nft rules implies effective prioritization.
unknowns: Exact target qdisc/class counters are not present in the simulated fixture.

validation_plan.step: Saturate the real egress bottleneck while generating C2, telemetry, and media traffic.
validation_plan.pass_condition: C2 remains within the project latency/loss budget and outranks telemetry/media under saturation.

research_trace.note: Offline fixture representing a primary-source lookup.

evidence.claim_supported: Configuration exists but runtime proof is missing.

evidence_coverage.note: Real counters and impairment measurements remain required.
